query:
Given the post-measurement distribution of qubits $(\mathcal{A,D})$,
what are the expressions for their polarization vectors $P_\mathcal{A}^i,P_\mathcal{D}^i$ in terms of the averages of the angle of the decay products $\Omega_{\mathcal{A}},\Omega_{\mathcal{D}}$ and the average of $f(\Omega_{\mathcal{B}},\Omega_{\mathcal{C}})$?
response:
ESULT:
P_{\mathcal A}^{\,i,\rm post}=\dfrac{3}{\kappa_{\mathcal A}\,\langle f\rangle}\,\langle \Omega_{\mathcal A}^i\,f(\Omega_{\mathcal B},\Omega_{\mathcal C})\rangle,\qquad
P_{\mathcal D}^{\,i,\rm post}=\dfrac{3}{\kappa_{\mathcal D}\,\langle f\rangle}\,\langle \Omega_{\mathcal D}^i\,f(\Omega_{\mathcal B},\Omega_{\mathcal C})\rangle.

Summary: The post-measurement single-qubit polarizations equal the pre-measurement rescaling (3/κ) of the mean decay-direction, but with the conditional (post) mean given by the full-distribution correlator divided by ⟨f⟩. These formulas use ⟨X⟩post = ⟨X f⟩/⟨f⟩.
